Package index

Reference sample selection and MMD-VAE normalisation

Identify samples whose covariance structure is most central to the cohort, then train an MMD-VAE for domain adaptation across batches and apply it to new samples.

computeReferenceSample()
Compute Reference Sample Based on Covariance Norms
trainVAEModel()
Train a Variational Autoencoder (VAE) with MMD Regularization
decodeSamples()
Decode New Samples Using VAE Decoder

Cell-type classification

Transfer cluster (or manually gated) cell-type labels from training to test data using the MMD-VAE latent representation.

trainCellTypeClassifier()
Train Cell Type Classifier using Caret

Sample-level features and hierarchy

Summarise each sample as cell-type proportions and per-cell-type marker means, then build the cell-type hierarchy that defines overlapping groups for the lasso.

computeFeatures()
Compute Features for Group Lasso Model
generateTree()
Generate Hierarchical Clustering Tree for Group Lasso
generateGroups()
Generate Hierarchical Groups from Clustering Tree
findChildren()
findChildren

Modelling

Fit the overlapping group lasso over the cell-type hierarchy.

fitModel()
Fit Overlapping Group Lasso Model

Interpretation and visualisation

Evaluate predictions, surface significant features, and visualise the learned cell-type hierarchy.

plotAUC()
Plot AUC for Model Evaluation
plotSigFeatures()
Plot Expression of Significant Features
visualiseModelTree()
Visualize Group Lasso Model Tree
getSigFeatures()
Get Significant Features from Group Lasso Model
